DECLARE @FCY VARCHAR(30)='{0}'; DECLARE @ITMREF VARCHAR(30)='{1}'; DECLARE @REMINQTY DECIMAL(16, 2)=0{2}; DECLARE @LOC VARCHAR(30)='{3}'; DECLARE @X9HNUM VARCHAR(30)='{4}'; SELECT N'lang:{zh:库位,en:Location,de:Lagerplatz}:' + K.LOC_0 + N'
lang:{zh:可用数量,en:Quantity,de:Menge}:' + Cast(Cast(K.QTYSTU_0-Isnull(XWS.QTY, 0) AS REAL) AS VARCHAR) +N'
lang:{zh:库存异常数量,en:Inventory Anomaly Qty,de:Bestandsabweichung}:' +CAST(CAST(K.CUMWIPQTY_0 AS REAL)AS varchar) + N'
lang:{zh:供应商批次,en:Supplier Lot,de:Chargen Nr.}:' + K.BPSLOT_0 + N'
lang:{zh:批次,en:Lot,de:charge}:' + K.LOT_0 + N'
lang:{zh:自定义字段1,en:Custom Field1,de:Benutzerdefiniertes1}:' + K.STOFLD1_0 + N'
lang:{zh:自定义字段2,en:Custom Field2,de:Benutzerdefiniertes2}:' + K.STOFLD2_0 + N'
lang:{zh:序列号,en:Serial number,de:Seriennummer}:' + K.SERNUM_0 选择 ,Cast(CASE WHEN K.SERNUM_0 <> '' THEN 1 WHEN K.QTYSTU_0 - Isnull(XWS.QTY, 0) > @REMINQTY AND K.SERNUM_0 = '' THEN @REMINQTY WHEN K.QTYSTU_0 - Isnull(XWS.QTY, 0) < 0 THEN 0 ELSE K.QTYSTU_0 - Isnull(XWS.QTY, 0) END AS REAL) 领料数量 ,K.LOC_0 库位 ,K.SERNUM_0 序列号 ,K.LOT_0 批次 ,CASE WHEN K.QTYSTU_0 - Isnull(XWS.QTY, 0) <= 0 THEN N'lang:{zh:可用库存不足,en:Insufficient Available Stock,de:Unzureichender verfügbarer Bestand}' ELSE 'OK' END AS 数据检查 ,K.PALNUM_0 生产计划号 ,K.STOCOU_0 STOCOU FROM STOCK K LEFT JOIN STOLOC STC ON K.STOFCY_0=STC.STOFCY_0 AND K.LOC_0=STC.LOC_0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT STOCOU_0 ,Sum(QTYSTU_0) QTY FROM XWSSCS WHERE RPFLG_0 <> 3 GROUP BY STOCOU_0 ,SERNUM_0)XWS ON XWS.STOCOU_0 = K.STOCOU_0 LEFT JOIN XCN09SGST C ON K.STOFCY_0=C.STOFCY_0 AND K.ITMREF_0=C.ITMREF_0 AND K.LOT_0=C.LOT_0 AND K.LOC_0=K.LOC_0 AND K.LOT_0=C.LOT_0 AND K.STOFLD1_0=C.STOFLD1_0 AND K.STOFLD2_0=C.STOFLD2_0 AND C.X9HNUM_0=@X9HNUM WHERE K.STOFCY_0 = @FCY AND K.ITMREF_0 = @ITMREF AND K.LOC_0 <> @LOC AND K.STA_0 LIKE 'A%' AND STC.YZUPAFSFLG_0<>2 AND ( -- 分支 1：如果 C 表有该物料的记录，则强制要求 K 表必须在 C 表中存在（只显示不是 NULL 的记录） ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM XCN09SGST C WHERE C.STOFCY_0 = @FCY AND C.ITMREF_0 = @ITMREF) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM XCN09SGST C WHERE K.STOFCY_0 = C.STOFCY_0 AND K.ITMREF_0 = C.ITMREF_0 AND K.LOT_0 = C.LOT_0 AND K.LOC_0 = C.LOC_0 AND K.LOT_0=C.LOT_0 AND K.STOFLD1_0=C.STOFLD1_0 AND K.STOFLD2_0=C.STOFLD2_0 AND X9HNUM_0=@X9HNUM ) ) OR -- 分支 2：如果 C 表里根本没有这个物料的记录（完全是 NULL），则直接放行 K 表原有的记录 NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM XCN09SGST C WHERE C.STOFCY_0 = @FCY AND C.ITMREF_0 = @ITMREF AND K.LOT_0= C.LOT_0 AND K.LOC_0 = C.LOC_0 AND K.LOT_0=C.LOT_0 AND K.STOFLD1_0=C.STOFLD1_0 AND K.STOFLD2_0=C.STOFLD2_0 AND X9HNUM_0=@X9HNUM ) );
